name: Maou ga Nokoshita Kokuin ~Kijou to Iu Na no Iki Jigoku~
original_name: 魔王が遺した刻淫～帰城と言う名のイキ地獄～
source:
The defeat of the demon lord was just the beginning, and the real adventure started on the way home...

A party of three beautiful heroines take down the demon lord, but not before it curses them with an emblem of lewdness.

The mark fills them with insatiable lust, and all reasoning is lost as they take on all comers!

Even with the strength to destroy the demon lord, by the power of the lewd emblem, they are simple sex-seeking girls.
No matter how filthy they find it, the pleasure drives them to corruption.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE280405.html] Dlsite English[/url]]
translation:
打败恶魔领主只是开始，真正的冒险从回家的路上开始……

三位美丽的女主角组成的队伍打倒了恶魔领主，但恶魔领主用淫荡的象征诅咒了她们。

这个印记让他们充满了贪得无厌的欲望，当他们攻击所有的对手时，所有的推理都失去了！

哪怕拥有毁灭魔王的实力，凭借淫纹的力量，她们也不过是单纯的寻色少女而已。
无论他们觉得多么肮脏，快乐都会驱使他们走向腐败。
